notes.title: Patch 5.39 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Patch Notes 5.39[/b][/h1]

Hi Everyone,

We wanted to take a moment to explain the recent changes to level 96-97 gameplay and assure you that this is not a nerf—it’s a recalibration to ensure long-term balance and fun for everyone. Here's what’s happening and why:



[h2][b]What Changed:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Previously, there was an unusually large jump in power at level 96 compared to earlier levels. This wasn’t consistent with the smooth progression from levels 1-95.
[*] We’ve adjusted the scaling for levels 96 and 97 to match the progression curve that has worked well for the game at all other levels.
[*] As part of this, both players and monsters at levels 96-97 will have less health and do less damage. But the balance remains the same—monsters are still more powerful than at level 95, and your character’s power remains in proportion to theirs.
[/list]


[h2][b]Why This Is a Good Thing:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Monsters at levels 96 and 97 were rebalanced too, meaning fights will feel fair and fun.
[*] We also gave crafted gear at levels 96-97 a slight boost, so it’s now even better than before.
[*] By fixing some bugs in the old system, we’ve ensured a smoother, more consistent gameplay experience moving forward.
[*] What It Means for You:
[*] Your character is not weaker compared to the game world. The numbers on your gear may look lower, but the effectiveness of your character is exactly as strong—or stronger—against the challenges you face.
[*] Raids and level 95 elder runs will now be slightly easier for level 97 players.
[/list]


[h2][b]Why We Made This Change:[/b][/h2]

We want to keep the game’s progression balanced and fair for everyone. The old jump at level 96 was fun in the short term but caused problems with balance that could have hurt the game in the long run. This is not just a subtle rebalancing-- it's fixing a design flaw. If we don't make this fix, then the system will remain broken and things will get more and more out of balance. This adjustment ensures everyone enjoys a smooth and rewarding experience, no matter where they are in the game, and provides the game with stability into the future.

We hope this clears up any confusion, but we’re always here to listen. If you have questions or concerns, feel free to share them—we’re committed to making Villagers & Heroes the best experience it can be.

Thank you for your understanding and support!



[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve adjusted the scaling for levels 96 and 97 to match the progression curve that has worked well for the game at all other levels.
[*] Harmonic Nectar can now be traded.
[*] Gulch now costs 100 Chits to enter (was 222). Rewards have also been adjusted:
[*] Myko chest now gives 16 Chits (was 29)
[*] Kaal chest now gives 32 Chits (was 78)
[*] Aene chest now gives 48 Chits (was 111). Additionally 1% bonus Chit amount is now 300 (was 666).
[*] Baun chest now gives 96 Chits (was 144). Additionally 1% bonus Chit amount is now 600 (was 888).
[*] Added blockers to the cliffsides in certain Gulch Elder warp points, so that players can't fall off and die.
[*] We changed the Ginny Gnogmentation Quest so that:
[*] It can be repeated with each Rebirth.
[*] It provides a reward of 2 free sockets.
[*] We gave level 96 crafted gear a power rating increase of +10.  We gave level 97 crafted gear a power rating increase of +15.  This is in addition to their natural boosts that come from being the highest level gear available.
[*] 
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [Fixed] Enhancement sometimes makes the item worse.
[*] Fixed an issue that cause Socorro Guild Discount to not apply.
[*] The effect, "Gulch Stamp" now only lasts for 30 minutes (was 2 hours).
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue that caused players to sometimes get locked out of raids, and required a server reset to fix them.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused raid lives to be consumed while the raid wasn't ongoing.
[*] After death bosses in the Gulch will now create a portal that teleports players that stand within it to the next section. This portal lasts for 30 seconds.
[*] Reduced the bounty respawn timer on some Southwestern Crux bosses, so that if players defeat an early one faster than previously, they can still get all the rewards from the rest.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.26.4
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://giant.gfycat.com/RichCluelessCoelacanth.gif[/IMG]

[h1]Patch 3.26.4[/h1]

Sugarsweet Summit has arrived!  Everyone's favorite, happy, event zone is back, and we've got some great new outfits and mounts for you this year!  Additionally, this build features a good many new improvements, and lots of bug fixes, and the addition of French!  :)


[b] Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Made some efficiency changes to Ardent City, players should see improved FPS while in the zone.
[*]French has been added to V&H!  (As well as the rest of Portuguese.)  To play the game in French, go to Settings < Options < Language.
[*]Adjusted which markers are shown on top in the map, to make it easier to see party members, bounties, and quests.
[*]Bounty markers now turn gray when you have completed them for the day or they are inactive.  (Previously they would turn gray when they were not spawned.)
[*]Emote popups now appear over the heads of any character that does an emote.
[*]Updated quest icons on the map and above NPCs:
[LIST]
[*]Available main quests are shown with a purple "!"
[*]Destinations within a main quest are shown with a purple "?"
[*]The completing objective in a main quest is shown with a purple star
[*]Available side quests are shown with a yellow "!"
[*]Destinations within a side quest are shown with a yellow "?"
[*]The completing objective in a side quest is shown with a yellow star
[/LIST]
[*][b]Sugarsweet Summit has arrived![/b]  New outfits!  New mounts!  And a few more fun tidbits!
[/LIST]


[b] Bug Fixes[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Added a far bank to the eastern side of the southern portion of the fishing river in the village.
[*]Fixed a hole in Bevyn's Coille.
[*]Added some fishing nodes to Goblin Roots Caves.
[*]Clarified Lil' Pip's text to explain that you must be at least level 75 to use his experience boosting services.
[*]The quest 'Cora Control' now correctly tracks.
[*]Fixed a few zombies that would get stuck on trees in Zombie town.
[*]Fixed a stuck location near Coalshark.
[*]Fixed a stuck locale in Dundeen Quarry.
[*]Fixed some typos in the Black Thrush storyline.
[*]Fixed a potential exploit.
[*]Fixed: bounty icons in minimap flicker.
[*]Fixed: in friends window, offline friends incorrectly say they're "Level 1 Warrior", and online friends often show out-of-date zone.
[*]Fixed Articulation Restoration track points were not that accurate.
[*]Fixed a stray drake in Sailors End.
[*]Fixed a hole in Knockroe wall.
[*]Fixed it so if you lose Archaic Symbol Note, your quest progress won't be blocked.
[*]Fixed: chat bubble text wasn't being centered correctly.
[*]Fixed: in very rare cases, a rebirth could fail.
[*]Fixed: in certain rare cases, the Make New Auction window wouldn't close after pressing Make (although the auction would start anyway).
[*]Fixed: on PC, normal friends were sometimes shown in the guild member list too.
[*]Fixed: shift-clicking on items to move them into the vault would not always stack.
[*]When you receive a new quest, "Track Quest" button is now to the left, instead of right, of "OK" button.
[*]Fixed: Gontier had his legs in the ground.
[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Shadow's Den.
[*]Fixed: NPCs would sometimes be stuck standing in a T-pose.
[*]Fixed a very rare case where players could get the NPC Aislinn in a weird state during her quest in Bearhold Crypt.
[*]Unearthed some berry bushes in Siren's Course.
[*]Clarified the goal text for 'The Brindle Rebellion' to note that a player must do a few tasks before Perdita will accept the badge.
[*]Added some clarifying text to the achievement "Pelog Grinder"
[*]Fixed: Salvaging Rods, Repair Kits, and certain other items would be "dropped" from the cursor when used on an item, instead of staying so they could be used again.
[*]Fixed several issues for players with unicode characters in their names.
[*]Fixed: After completing the quest with Winifred, her exclamation would stay up.
[*]Fixed a bounty that would spawn on a tent in Pyrron Courtyard.
[*]Fixed: dropping mail items into a stack would move the items, but would leave a fake stack behind in mail until you closed and reopened the mail.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch 3.24.6
notes.notes:
[h1] Patch 3.24.6[/h1] 

[IMG]http://giant.gfycat.com/IdolizedAccomplishedKentrosaurus.gif[/IMG]

Hi, Everyone! Grinchta and gang have departed, but we've got a meaty little build to keep you all busy in the mean time. :)

New lower level content! ('King Leo and The Rise of the Black Thrush.')  Lots of mobile improvements!  Bug fixes galore!  New maps and icons!  A slew of 'under the hood' alterations to improve lag and delays! And much, much, more!


[b]Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Inventory and item control now is much more responsive and robust.  
[*]Zone maps for levels 1-25 have been much altered and improved.
[*]Most zone map icons have been redesigned to be clearer.
[*]Updated zone map grid and letters on PC to be more visible.
[*]Fishing spots in all zones are MUCH more visible, and the fish can actually be seen swimming in them!
[*]Citizens of Lake Kiwa have been busy. Lake Kiwa now includes all gathering nodes from level 1 to level 25.
[*]Added water wells in the Marigold crafting area.
[*]New voiced lines have been added to the story content for levels 11-25!
[*][B]New Lower Level Content![/B] The story of The Black Thrush continues, right where it left off in Ardent Castle, and will take players from level 15 up to level 25. It's a long and involved quest line, which, in addition to having some exciting new gameplay surprises within it, also features a great many zones that have been made wondrously new again!  The following zones have all had cosmetic surgery and/or alterations made to them (and maybe even a few new bounties!):
[LIST]
[*]Trader's Path
[*]Southern Coast
[*]Southern Marsh
[*]Lake Kiwa
[*]Sea Caves
[*]Siren's Course
[*]Sailor's End
[*]Zombie Town
[*]The Sewer's of Ardent
[*]Green Gate
[*]Forever's Advent
[*]Forever Tree
[/LIST]
[/LIST]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Internal changes to improve the stability of effects, preventing them from disappearing even during server failure.
[*]Fixed: sometimes a quest tracker slot could get stuck.
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking on feats rapidly and repeatedly would cause massive (5 - 10+ seconds) latency and throttling.
[*]Improved reliability of pingPyC counter.
[*]Crowns sales and item sales are now shown directly in the front page of the Shop, and the number of bonus crowns are shown in the Buy Crowns page.
[*]Changed the name of Rat King to just Rat.
[*]Replaced some confusing bounties.
[*]Fixed it so Arcron casts his magic in the right spot again.
[*]Fixed a bad mining rock in Gandymeade Grove.
[*]Fixed Garrin's cave to be more homey.
[*]Fixed some trees in Lady's lake that could capture players in their leaves.
[*]Fixed some bad mushroom nodes.
[*]Make Cornelius say something after Samuel vanishes to help guide players.
[*]Fixed an issue where players with increased combat speed would have their Benevolent potion visual effect (not actual gameplay effect) run out before the duration expired.
[*]Removed Bounty Master zone achievements.
[*]Fixed a gathering issue. If there is an extreme difference in level between the players skill level and the node, the chance to find the item is now 0% instead of 1%. If you 'did not find anything' during a gather, you are unable to find Motes of Yorick, Repair Globules, Lucky Gems, and Supplies.
[*]Made fishing holes in Maiden easier to see.
[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Kingsport.
[*]Dropped Balfoure's toupee quantity needed from 4 to 2. Boosted the drop rate from 75% chance to 100% chance.
[*]Dropped the mud dobber and cream popper quantity needed from 3 to 1 each. Each item only has a single node that now directly guides / tracks the player to the spot.
[*]Added more clarifying text to Gandymeade gossip quest goals to help the players find the gossip easily.
[*]Decreased the shadows in Pyrron dungeons .
[*]Fixed a stuck location in Bellacove Tide-pools.
[*]Fixed it so certain mobs that should be quiet won't be screaming out in a human voice.
[*]Fixed it so Maradar spores can be seen.
[*]Added fishing nodes to the areas in the tutorial where NPCs are fishing so new players don't get confused.
[*]Went through all tutorial quest text and added clarifying locations about which zones the goal takes place in.
[*]Fixed a rare case where players could get stuck not being able to turn in the quest "Finding Lorcan" to Rosemunda.
[*]Fixed a stuck location near Lady's Fate.
[*]Fixed it so master Gathering quest in tutorial no longer mentions "upper ethos".
[*]Made Eamon look a bit less cartoony.
[*]Updated a few very small things in Summer's Hollow to make the experience better for new players.
[*]Removed the word 'reins' from mount items.
[*]Added some clarifying text in the Pyrrus leaflet delivery quest. Some players believe they are bugged, but most likely it is because they do not have the leaflets in their inventory. The goal will now instruct them to return to Bianca if they have lost the leaflets.
[*]Fixed an issue that would not allow ear mites to drop anymore if you lost yours for Rafferty's quest. Also updated some completed text for larynx worms to clarify that you need seven of them.
[*]Fixed a case where a player could get stuck after giving Nadia Tufts of Boar fur.
[*]The auctioneers ledger is no longer available for Red Doubloons. It was buggy and caused issues.
[*]Tweaked balance numbers on Red Darrig world drop rates. Chest chances have gone down, key rates have gone up.
[*]Fixed a case where players couldn't find Dionte in Lampkin Village after completing Defusing the Feud. If this has happened to you, you'll need to go back to Dionte near the Mire of Shame and talk through his dialog fully.
[*]Clarified a section of the Viperous Viceroy in Cronk Island by adding a special waypoint that the players much reach, which then instructs the players to talk to Nikodem. This should help players who are confused by speaking with Tarquin first.
[*]Maplecrest no longer requires characters to do the tutorial.
[*]The quest "Thirsty for Life" now correctly tracks.
[*]Fixed the quest "Bumps in the Night" to correctly track.
[*]Added CW007 to our memorial list. :(
[*]Fixed a stuck tree spot in Kingsport.
[*]Fixed an issue where players teleporting to Priest Chambers could fall out of the world.
[*]Fixed: some non-human NPCs would appear frozen.
[*]Fixed some bad fishing holes in Memorial Pond.
[*]Hopefully fixed: occasional wobbling and rubber-banding after a resurrect.
[*]Fixed: zoning using the map while a mob is selected would make it impossible to select other mobs.
[*]Fixed an issue where you would teleport under the ground in the market and grove teleports of Ardent City.
[*]Fixed: the "Visit Now" button would not work even if you had an Ardent Membership.
[/LIST]


[b]Misc.[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Grinchta's Lair has been removed.
[/LIST]

notes.notes:
This is a follow-up, fix-it build to the last patch.  We've also made some significant changes to the drop rates in the Equinox event zone.

[b] Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Equinox Changes
[LIST]
[*]The chance of finding wings from a Pharaoh's chest: 1% -> 6%
[*]The chance of finding wings from a Caliph's chest: 0.4% -> 7%
[*]The chance of finding a Djinn Fairy Lamp in a Sand Darrig's chest: 0.5% -> 1.5%
[*]The chance of finding relic shards in a Darrig chest has remained the same, but when you do find them, you find more.
[*][B][U]Important note[/U]: We have heard and read lots of feedback about Equinox. Players do not like pure random luck! Let it be heard, let it be done! Spooky Town (and future event zones) will not rely on these luck mechanics (there may still be little luck mechanics here and there, but it won't be in this quantity or severity)[/B].
[/LIST]
[*]Warrior Feat Icons: Phoenix Strike and Whirlwind were updated to better convey their meanings
[/LIST]


[b] Bug Fixes[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing bountiful watering pitchers to be sold for 1c. After this patch goes live,  bountiful watering pitchers that were obtained via this bug will be deleted from player inventories.
[*]Fixed: when using a ranged feat to target and attack an enemy, character would run towards the enemy.  Character now only runs to get into range required by the feat, no closer.
[LIST]
[*]Note that fixing this required reverting another fix, where using a feat with no spirit left would turn off auto-attack.
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed: doors would snap closed the moment they were opened.
[*]Fixed: jumping with Gnomish Jumping Boots stopped playing a flip animation due to a bug.
[*]Fixed: issues with chat tabs and party pane becoming messed up.
[*]Some players reported an error with the boss Zagreb. Turns out all these years he has been bugged, making him very easy. This recent patch actually fixed this bug, so he suddenly is very hard (as he was always intended to be). However since he is no longer a main elder boss, we lowered some of the mechanics that are now making him slightly too powerful.
[*]Fixed a bug where common level 1 gathering items could be found in the event zone.
[*]Fixed a bug where NPCs in the event zone were saying incorrect things about the outfits they were wearing.
[/LIST]

[h1] Patch Notes 3.19.3[/h1] 

With this build comes the removal of The Twilight Vale, but we do have some exciting new improvements for you all (gambling chests!) and the always needed bug fixes.  :)


[h1] Improvements[/h1] 
[LIST]
[*]New feature: Chests of the Red Darrig![LIST]
[*][*]Chests of the Red Darrig are new items to the game. Players can open a chest of the red darrig for a chance at great rewards. Chests may contain:[LIST]
[*][b]Powerful Consumables:[/b] May contain powerful items from the shop, or even exclusive rare and powerful potions.
[*][b]Expansive Outfits:[/b] May contain just about any outfit in the Seven Realms, even those out of season, or otherwise unavailable!
[*][b]Red Doubloons:[/b] These special coins can be used to purchase items from Flynn McRufus in Ardent City.[/LIST]
[*]Any item that is found in a Chest of the Red Darrig can be sold to a new vendor, Flynn McRufus in Ardent City (up by the castle), for his currency, Red Doubloons. Using this currency, players can collect outfits, special items, and rare consumables.
[*][B]Chests can be gained in one of two ways:[/B][LIST]
[*]Chests will be sold in the shop, 10 crowns each (or 10 for 90 crowns).
[*]Locked chests can also be found in the world as rare drops from monsters. However to open a locked chest, you'll need a key.

notes.title: Patch 3.17.7
notes.notes:
Hello, Everyone!  We have a large and exciting build for you all!  In addition to a great many bug fixes, we have also done a complete overhaul to the monster parts system in the game, added new story content to the lower levels, and, last but not least, have added the Midsummer's special event zone, The Twilight Vale.  Enjoy!  :)

[h1] The Midsummer's Event Returns!  Featuring:[/h1] 
[LIST]
[*]The return of the Twlight Vale, and special event zone where all players are equalized to the same level.
[*]9 brand new event quests, plus quests from last year, and 2 dailies, a total of 13! (lots to do!)
[*]The bounty ladder returns against the council of the five fae!
[*]16 outfits [B]IN[/B] the event, with 6 of the outfits being brand new!
[*]A new rare boss that spawns in the vale 
[*]Various treats and goodies to help you in your adventures!
[*]Ardent City put up its midsummer lights, and set up their firework system
[*][I]Special Note: Some of the new quests and tasks in the event may be very difficult for certain players. This was intentional as these quests give players the chance at earning amazing new outfits. Players can choose what outfit they wish to pursue, or maybe have a friend help them and get a few. What you do is up to you![/I]
[/LIST]


[h1]New Story Content Added For Levels 10 - 15[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]This is the first of a three part story line segment, so think of it as 'Part One.'  It picks up right where the Malicious Miscreant quest left off - in Ardent Castle, speaking to Lady Philippa.  [I](In order to start the quest a player needs to have either finished the 'Malicious Miscreant' quest line, or be a minimum level of 10)[/I]
[*]Several zones have had visual make-overs
[LIST]
[*]Addicts Ascent has been completely re-done
[*]Bearhold Valley has been much enhanced (pssst! check out the bear, too!)
[*]Bearhold Crypt is greatly improved
[*]Memorial Pond, Lady's Lake, Kingsport, and Elk Meadow have all had alterations made
[*]Ardent Castle has a new chamber
[/LIST][/LIST]


[h1]Monster Parts System Improvements[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]All existing fangs, milk, scales, silk, horns, claws, bristles, quills, and tusks have been removed from the game. These items have been replaced with 9 single items. This means there are [b]169[/b] fewer items that players have to collect and manage.
[*]The new monster parts have a new simple naming scheme, with a few parts being renamed:
[LIST]
[*]Fang, Bone (changed from Tusks), Scales, Claw, Ichor (changed from Milk), Horn, Silk, Barb (changed from quill), and Fur (changed from bristles).[/LIST]
[*]The new versions of monster parts are leveless, meaning they drop at any level, and they are used in all of the places that the existing monster parts were used [I]e.g. if a recipe required 10 ‘Tiny Fangs’ it now requires 10 ‘Fangs’.[/I]
[*]Pelts and the various level versions of pelts remain unchanged. 
[*]Monster parts now drop from specific enemy types. This is listed in the items description and in the item browser (from the Knowledge Book or from the Crafting Window). Additionally, enemies have a new line in their description if you mouse over their cameo that tells what types of things they may drop. 
[/LIST]
[b]Pelts and Leather[/b]: [I]There has also been requests from players concerning the rarity of pelts and the need of them for hunter gear. [/I]
[LIST]
[*]To help address this, all enemies have been divided into two categories, “Humanoids”, and “Beasts.” Beasts will function like before, dropping pelts. However anything that is a humanoid will instead drop already processed leather (of their level range). This should give hunters an easier time collecting the items they need for crafting. Mousing over an enemy will tell you whether it will drop pelts or leather.
[*]Before these changes, the typical chance to get a pelt from any monster was 24.6%. We have boosted this to a 35% chance. However, any humanoid creature that drops leather will drop at a 30% rate.
[/LIST]

[b]Other Monster Part Related Changes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]The monster parts vendor now only sells pelts up to level 15 and is now labeled as a "Pelt" vendor.
[*]The monster parts charter has been removed from the game
[*]Recipes level 15 and below no longer require any monster part
[*]Monster parts are now listed as a green superior rarity
[*]Monster part icons and 3d loot have been improved
[*]Almost all old monster parts will be converted to the new system after this patch goes live. Low level parts that used to be sold from the Monster Part vendor will [B]NOT[/B] be converted (these items will become useless junk items to be thrown away).
[*]Because of the new slimmed down versions, all monster parts have been removed from village projects (except pelts).
[/LIST]

[b]Fish[/b]:[I]We did some minor cleanup on fish caught from the fishing skill.[/I]
[LIST]
[*]The following items have been removed:
[LIST][*][*]Banded Butterfish, Crawdad, Bass, Redhorse, Boxfish
[*][I]Any player who had these items will have them converted to other fish of similar level. Any recipe that used these items has been updated and renamed.[/I][/LIST]
[*]The naming scheme for fish has been changed. Instead of a “shiny” and “glistening” alternative, there instead is a small, normal, and large variant. All fish have had their icons and names updated to reflect this simpler system.
[*]All decoctions have had their icons updated. 
[/LIST]

[b]Icons[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Several in game icons have been improved
[/LIST]

[b]Zogs[/b]
Because of some of the changes with monster parts we had to update the zog system. We decided to add some extra benefit to zogs for players.
[LIST]
[*]Zogs now have a rarity system. There are common, uncommon, rare, and ultra rare zogs. Zogs from various races have been arbitrarily broken up into these rarity classes. For example, a Spider zog is a common, and a Ghost zog is an ultra rare. Rarity changes the drop chance of a zog.
[*]Zogs can still be redeemed as they always could at the zog redemption agent in Traders path. However after a zog has been redeemed, the player unlocks the ability to perform zog contracts. 
[*]Zog contracts are simply turning in 5 of the same zog to the redemption agent. Doing this gives a reward based on rarity:
[LIST]
[*]Common: An emerald
[*]Uncommon: A Diamond
[*]Rare: A random elixir
[*]Ultra Rare: 25 crowns
[/LIST]
[*]Zog contracts can be performed any number of times (as long as you have the zogs for it!)
[*]All zog related achievements have been removed
[*]Because of cleaning up and combining certain races, several zogs have been removed from the game. All of these zogs will be converted after the patch to other types of zogs.
[*]Because the new system has and high level of rewards, all current in game zogs have been converted down to ‘common’ zogs. Uncommon, rare, and ultra rare zogs can only be found while adventuring. However if a player has already redeemed a zog they will still have credit for doing so.
[*]Because zogs have new and better uses, they have been removed from all village projects.
[/LIST]


[b]XP Table Balancing[/b]
[I]We have reduced XP tables for gathering, crafting, gardening and ranching.[/I]
[LIST]
[*][B]Gathering and Crafting[/B] have been reduced to make it easier to keep skills in line with combat level. In particular, levels 1-30 are significantly easier, and levels 31-70 are fairly easier. Levels 71-Max had a slight reduction but remain mostly the same.
[*][B]Gardening and Ranching[/B] have both had their XP tables severely reduced. These skills are both already time gated, making them very difficult to keep in line with combat. Both of these activities require player skill (what to plant, collecting food, when to water, etc.) as well as a fair amount of management. We feel that these things are the 'gate' to the skills, and XP tables shouldn't be something that gets in the way of these activities.
[*][B]Combat tables[/B] were unchanged.
[/LIST]

[b]Crafting Recipe Changes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]The amount of basic refined ingredients needed for all recipes has been lowered. As an example, a level 79 warrior armor went from 175 pigs to 136.
[*]In addition to the change above, the amount of leather needed for hunter gear has been additionally reduced. As an example, a level 79 Hunter tunic went from 157 leather to 97.
[*]Reduced the amount of elemental fleece needed for fire, ice, shadow, and holy gear.
[*]Gloves, Boots, and Belts went from alternating 10 / 15, to alternating 5 / 10 (reduced by 5 each)
[*]Outfits went from alternating 30 / 60, to alternating 20 / 40 (ten and twenty reduction)
[*]Doubled the chance to get a legendary crafted item if the player has a 5 star rank in the recipe (from 15% to 30%)
[/LIST] 



[h1]Other Game Improvements[/h1]

[LIST]
[*]Tracked quest arrows! Tracked quests now have arrows that direct you to nearby goals.
[*]Starting on June 17th, characters on new accounts will have a default move speed of 65, instead of 100. This will NOT affect accounts created before June 17th. This will NOT affect new characters created after June 17th on accounts that were created before June 17th.  This will ONLY affect entirely new accounts (i.e. email/password or Steam account never used on a given server before) from June 17th onward.
[*]We changed the wallaby boot reward in Summer's Hollow. Wallaby boots were changed to 'Gnomish Wallaby Slippers' and are now given out as the prize for completing the Malicious Miscreant and no longer contain the speed portion. Now, instead after completing Hilda's quest, the player will receive a 1 hour long speed bonus equal to that of Celestia's Helm of Alacrity (the duration of the speed buff will only tick down if the user is logged IN).
[*]We made liberty drams a bit better by giving them a level lead vs. the level needed to use, e.g. before a level 65 potion would protect you against level 65 and lower enemies, but now a level 65 potion protects you again level 69 and lower enemies.
[*]Boosted the drop chance of Bileweed Bubblegum
[*]There was an issue where certain players would be prevented from doing Cyprian's daily bacon quest. So we reworked it a bit, adding a few more variations and a slightly better reward.
[/LIST]



[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed: some missing water in a pond in Greengate

[*]Characters level 10 and under (who have not completed a rebirth) are no longer require to use a Voltan's Resurrect to resurrect on the spot. This is to help newcomers get familiar with the game by making death less punishing.

[*]The return of the Twlight Vale, and special event zone where all players are equalized to the same level.
[*]9 brand new event quests, plus quests from last year, and 2 dailies, a total of 13! (lots to do!)
[*]The bounty ladder returns against the council of the five fae!
[*]16 outfits [B]IN[/B] the event, with 6 of the outfits being brand new!
[*]A new rare boss that spawns in the vale 
[*]Various treats and goodies to help you in your adventures!
[*]Ardent City put up its midsummer lights, and set up their firework system
[*][I]Special Note: Some of the new quests and tasks in the event may be very difficult for certain players. This was intentional as these quests give players the chance at earning amazing new outfits. Players can choose what outfit they wish to pursue, or maybe have a friend help them and get a few. What you do is up to you![/I]
[/LIST]


[h1]New Story Content Added For Levels 10 - 15[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]This is the first of a three part story line segment, so think of it as 'Part One.'  It picks up right where the Malicious Miscreant quest left off - in Ardent Castle, speaking to Lady Philippa.  [I](In order to start the quest a player needs to have either finished the 'Malicious Miscreant' quest line, or be a minimum level of 10)[/I]
[*]Several zones have had visual make-overs
[LIST]
[*]Addicts Ascent has been completely re-done
[*]Bearhold Valley has been much enhanced (pssst! check out the bear, too!)
[*]Bearhold Crypt is greatly improved
[*]Memorial Pond, Lady's Lake, Kingsport, and Elk Meadow have all had alterations made
[*]Ardent Castle has a new chamber
[/LIST][/LIST]


[h1]Monster Parts System Improvements[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]All existing fangs, milk, scales, silk, horns, claws, bristles, quills, and tusks have been removed from the game. These items have been replaced with 9 single items. This means there are [b]169[/b] fewer items that players have to collect and manage.
[*]The new monster parts have a new simple naming scheme, with a few parts being renamed:
[LIST]
[*]Fang, Bone (changed from Tusks), Scales, Claw, Ichor (changed from Milk), Horn, Silk, Barb (changed from quill), and Fur (changed from bristles).[/LIST]
[*]The new versions of monster parts are leveless, meaning they drop at any level, and they are used in all of the places that the existing monster parts were used [I]e.g. if a recipe required 10 ‘Tiny Fangs’ it now requires 10 ‘Fangs’.[/I]
[*]Pelts and the various level versions of pelts remain unchanged. 
[*]Monster parts now drop from specific enemy types. This is listed in the items description and in the item browser (from the Knowledge Book or from the Crafting Window). Additionally, enemies have a new line in their description if you mouse over their cameo that tells what types of things they may drop. 
[/LIST]
[b]Pelts and Leather[/b]: [I]There has also been requests from players concerning the rarity of pelts and the need of them for hunter gear. [/I]
[LIST]
[*]To help address this, all enemies have been divided into two categories, “Humanoids”, and “Beasts.” Beasts will function like before, dropping pelts. However anything that is a humanoid will instead drop already processed leather (of their level range). This should give hunters an easier time collecting the items they need for crafting. Mousing over an enemy will tell you whether it will drop pelts or leather.
[*]Before these changes, the typical chance to get a pelt from any monster was 24.6%. We have boosted this to a 35% chance. However, any humanoid creature that drops leather will drop at a 30% rate.
[/LIST]

[b]Other Monster Part Related Changes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]The monster parts vendor now only sells pelts up to level 15 and is now labeled as a "Pelt" vendor.
[*]The monster parts charter has been removed from the game
[*]Recipes level 15 and below no longer require any monster part
[*]Monster parts are now listed as a green superior rarity
[*]Monster part icons and 3d loot have been improved
[*]Almost all old monster parts will be converted to the new system after this patch goes live. Low level parts that used to be sold from the Monster Part vendor will [B]NOT[/B] be converted (these items will become useless junk items to be thrown away).
[*]Because of the new slimmed down versions, all monster parts have been removed from village projects (except pelts).
[/LIST]

[b]Fish[/b]:[I]We did some minor cleanup on fish caught from the fishing skill.[/I]
[LIST]
[*]The following items have been removed:
[LIST][*][*]Banded Butterfish, Crawdad, Bass, Redhorse, Boxfish
[*][I]Any player who had these items will have them converted to other fish of similar level. Any recipe that used these items has been updated and renamed.[/I][/LIST]
[*]The naming scheme for fish has been changed. Instead of a “shiny” and “glistening” alternative, there instead is a small, normal, and large variant. All fish have had their icons and names updated to reflect this simpler system.
[*]All decoctions have had their icons updated. 
[/LIST]

[b]Icons[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Several in game icons have been improved
[/LIST]

[b]Zogs[/b]
Because of some of the changes with monster parts we had to update the zog system. We decided to add some extra benefit to zogs for players.
[LIST]
[*]Zogs now have a rarity system. There are common, uncommon, rare, and ultra rare zogs. Zogs from various races have been arbitrarily broken up into these rarity classes. For example, a Spider zog is a common, and a Ghost zog is an ultra rare. Rarity changes the drop chance of a zog.
[*]Zogs can still be redeemed as they always could at the zog redemption agent in Traders path. However after a zog has been redeemed, the player unlocks the ability to perform zog contracts. 
[*]Zog contracts are simply turning in 5 of the same zog to the redemption agent. Doing this gives a reward based on rarity:
[LIST]
[*]Common: An emerald
[*]Uncommon: A Diamond
[*]Rare: A random elixir
[*]Ultra Rare: 25 crowns
[/LIST]
[*]Zog contracts can be performed any number of times (as long as you have the zogs for it!)
[*]All zog related achievements have been removed
[*]Because of cleaning up and combining certain races, several zogs have been removed from the game. All of these zogs will be converted after the patch to other types of zogs.
[*]Because the new system has and high level of rewards, all current in game zogs have been converted down to ‘common’ zogs. Uncommon, rare, and ultra rare zogs can only be found while adventuring. However if a player has already redeemed a zog they will still have credit for doing so.
[*]Because zogs have new and better uses, they have been removed from all village projects.
[/LIST]


[b]XP Table Balancing[/b]
[I]We have reduced XP tables for gathering, crafting, gardening and ranching.[/I]
[LIST]
[*][B]Gathering and Crafting[/B] have been reduced to make it easier to keep skills in line with combat level. In particular, levels 1-30 are significantly easier, and levels 31-70 are fairly easier. Levels 71-Max had a slight reduction but remain mostly the same.
[*][B]Gardening and Ranching[/B] have both had their XP tables severely reduced. These skills are both already time gated, making them very difficult to keep in line with combat. Both of these activities require player skill (what to plant, collecting food, when to water, etc.) as well as a fair amount of management. We feel that these things are the 'gate' to the skills, and XP tables shouldn't be something that gets in the way of these activities.
[*][B]Combat tables[/B] were unchanged.
[/LIST]

[b]Crafting Recipe Changes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]The amount of basic refined ingredients needed for all recipes has been lowered. As an example, a level 79 warrior armor went from 175 pigs to 136.
[*]In addition to the change above, the amount of leather needed for hunter gear has been additionally reduced. As an example, a level 79 Hunter tunic went from 157 leather to 97.
[*]Reduced the amount of elemental fleece needed for fire, ice, shadow, and holy gear.
[*]Gloves, Boots, and Belts went from alternating 10 / 15, to alternating 5 / 10 (reduced by 5 each)
[*]Outfits went from alternating 30 / 60, to alternating 20 / 40 (ten and twenty reduction)
[*]Doubled the chance to get a legendary crafted item if the player has a 5 star rank in the recipe (from 15% to 30%)
[/LIST] 



[h1]Other Game Improvements[/h1]

[LIST]
[*]Tracked quest arrows! Tracked quests now have arrows that direct you to nearby goals.
[*]Starting on June 17th, characters on new accounts will have a default move speed of 65, instead of 100. This will NOT affect accounts created before June 17th. This will NOT affect new characters created after June 17th on accounts that were created before June 17th.  This will ONLY affect entirely new accounts (i.e. email/password or Steam account never used on a given server before) from June 17th onward.
[*]We changed the wallaby boot reward in Summer's Hollow. Wallaby boots were changed to 'Gnomish Wallaby Slippers' and are now given out as the prize for completing the Malicious Miscreant and no longer contain the speed portion. Now, instead after completing Hilda's quest, the player will receive a 1 hour long speed bonus equal to that of Celestia's Helm of Alacrity (the duration of the speed buff will only tick down if the user is logged IN).
[*]We made liberty drams a bit better by giving them a level lead vs. the level needed to use, e.g. before a level 65 potion would protect you against level 65 and lower enemies, but now a level 65 potion protects you again level 69 and lower enemies.
[*]Boosted the drop chance of Bileweed Bubblegum
[*]There was an issue where certain players would be prevented from doing Cyprian's daily bacon quest. So we reworked it a bit, adding a few more variations and a slightly better reward.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch 3.15.18
notes.notes:
Hello, Everyone!  We have a rather large new build for you all.  Sugarsweet Summit is gone, but in its place you will find a great many bug fixes and improvements to the game in general.  We have also done a massive overhaul on the tutorial zones, one which new and rebirthed players alike are sure to find, we believe, to their liking.  And last but not least, we have implemented a new bug tracking software system into this build, which will benefit us all greatly from here on out!  Please visit our forums to learn more about it, and all about our new, 'no-more-reporting-bugs-on-the-forums' policy.  (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?12847-New-Bug-Reporting-System)

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[LIST]
[*]In-game bug reports can now take screenshots!  [B]Press: 'CTRL-ALT-B'[/B]
[*]Bidders in the Auction House are now listed as being anonymous
[*]House License requirement has been removed
[*]Improved the animation of monsters so that they no longer appear to be ‘sliding.’
[*]Removed the Vim Invitational Rune
[*]The animation for Pyrrus Golems attack is a little bit faster, but their damage was lowered.
[*] No trade items can now be sold to vendors (e.g. Rings from Maldwyn's Tomb).
[*] A lot of toys and spells that involved things moving along or settling on the ground will now work even if you aren't on 'terrain' (for example, the streets of Ardent and a campfire).
[*]We have removed the old and deprecated "Superior Glittershade Pig" from the game.
[*]Players now get Grubella's eyeballs from a different source (no longer Grimbad who would only drop 1, which was a problem when more than 1 player was in a group).
[*]Removed some bounty master achievements for early zones and small zones.
[*]Elderbane and Elder Garde now have normal descriptions that will be localized (no more mention of the Rift).
[*]The buggy and broken "hunter / seeker' achievements have been removed from the game.
[*] Traven crafting recipes now marked as quest items to make sorting easier in Knowledge book
[*] Made it so when you hit the 'resurrect' or 'revive' button after death, the opposite button vanishes. This prevents players from accidentally clicking both during a lag spike, and possibly using a voltan's resurrect with no effect.
[*] Made a tweak to the quest "Eyes on the Prize" where you can't turn in the imperial documents if you are not on the quest, "Eyes on the Prize". (You still may be able to get the documents early if another player in your party has the quest and you don't, but you won't be able to turn them in until after having received the quest).
[*]Made a change so lower level enemies have less armor that scales up to be normal starting at level 11.
[*]Removed the Kingsport Insulter Achievement (it was buggy)
[*] We did a lighting pass on all of the zones in the game.  (HDR has been removed.)
[*]Sugarsweet Summit has been removed
[*]A new Starter zone, 'Gilly Tunnel,' has been added
[*]Tutorial Zones (Ethos, Lower Ethos, Summer's Hollow, Cronk Island) received an overhaul:
[LIST]
[*]Cronk Island now has a portal in Summer’s hollow, and can no longer be accessed via Lower Ethos
[*]Player now enters game in a central location within Summer’s Hollow
[*]Summer’s Hollow, Gandymeade Grove, and Marigold Marina are now separate zones with portals instead of Lower Ethos and Ethos on map.  (The blue line boundary has been removed.)
[*]Dagmar’s Strand (an area formally part of Lower Ethos) is now its own zone
[*]Summer’s Hollow has been ‘thinned out’ – fewer NPCs, quests, and objects. 
[*]A Portal to Villages has been added to Summer's Hollow
[*]Some NPC’s in the tutorial zones have been moved to make quests simpler.  Some NPCs have been removed altogether
[*]All of the main quests within The Mystery of the Malicious Miscreant have had alterations made to them to improve ease of quest flow
[*]Quest markers on the map have been streamlined for clarity
[*]The World Map has been updated
[*]Some quests have been removed, some quests have been added to help players through the new portals.
[*]Some quest items have been removed
[/LIST]
[/LIST]

notes.notes:
[h1]  Patch 3.13.0 - The Double Whammy Build! [/h1]




  [b]  Happy February, Everyone! This special patch contains new high level content, as well as the addition of Sugarsweet Summit, where players of any level can party down, battle candied fiends, and reap the rewards! [/b]




   [b] Improvementsv [/b]
[list]
     [*]   New content is here! Enter the 'Copse of the Treants' and pick up where the story left off in Bevyn's Coille. Dionte continues to need heroes to help prove his innocence, and end the war between the Spriggans and the Treants. New Content Features:
             [*] Level cap raise to 79 for all ten skills
             [*] New items, crafting recipes, drops, harvest plants and more.
             [*] Two New zones: The Copse of the Treants and Maldwyn's Tomb
             [*] The finale conclusion of 'Defusing the Feud' main story quest

             [*] Over 65 new bounty bosses
             [*] Extensive end game content with new epic loot
             [*] New achievements

             [*] New challenges in the form of mysteries to be solved, group content areas, rare zingara and more!

      [*]  Sugarsweet Summit has just swooped in with all of its candy loving fun and deliciously evil creatures! (Not to mention some lively new outfits and toys!)

   [*]     Player characters now have an all new jump animation!

   [*]    We've lowered the default aggro ranges. This will effect most enemies but not all. Changes are as follows (measured in world units, which is about equal to one meter):
             [*] Short Distance and Group Enemies: 13 -> 11
             [*] Normal Enemy: 23 -> 15
             [*] Bounty Boss (Green): 23 -> 23
             [*] Venerable Boss (Blue): 45 -> 35
             [*] Elder Boss (Purple): 45 -> 45

      [*]  We have added crown gifting packages. Players can buy these items and gift them to friends or sell them on the auction house (All sizes will sell for the exact amount given!):
             [*] Crown Bag
             [*] Crown Pouch
             [*] Crown Purse
             [*] Crown Satchel
             [*] Crown Chest
             [*] Royal Crown Coffer

      [*]  We removed the spam message that updated every rank of a talent earned after investing talents points.
[/list]

 [b]   Bug Fixes [/b]
[list]
    [*]    Fixed a bug that would break the Harbor Master from completing certain quests if the player had killed Philemon prior.
    [*]    Fixed a bug that was causing the effects of the starter talent "Scion of the Forest" to be bad for the player instead of good.
    [*]    Fixed: I noticed that when I claimed an achievement, that achievement kept blinking, even though it updated as being complete.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.7.5 is here! Part 2
notes.notes:
Continue on "improvements"

 [b] Lord Pyrrus Front Runners [/b]
      [*] A special 'souvenir' toy has been added noting the accomplishments of front runner players who completed all content while level cap was level 75.
      [*]  Any player who assembled a level 75 elder weapon or armor (collected fragments from Pyrrus and Crew and had Arcron restore it) before this patch 3.7 will be able to obtain the toy for free. You can head to the Arcane Rift of Pyrron and talk with Opalia who is near Elda. The check for the free toy is dependent on the level 75 achievement for elder gear which is now marked as legacy (a new achievement was added for future players). Since achievements do not reset with Rebirth, as long as you have the achievement completed, you will eventually be able to make your way back to level 75 and get the toy for free.
      [*]  Any player that wants the toy but does not have the achievement will be able to obtain the toy from the Brindle Chriton for a fee of 1400 gold. Chriton will only appear if a player has done the quest "Arcane Ascension."
      [*]  The free toy is only for those who have completed either the weapon or armor achievement. A player who completed the rift but did not create level 75 elder gear (either before or after a rebirth) will not be entitled to the free toy.
[*]    Players now slide along walls instead of just sticking to them. There are still a few kinks to work out, so please provide feedback.
[*]    Changed key remapping text to "Change key mapping to action:"
[*]    Abundant loot (from the stat "Mega Loot") now has a better chance of dropping 5x and 10x loot rather than 2x loot (which would often go unnoticed)
[*]    Potion of luck was boosted to 30% luck boost
[*]    If two of the same item are collected that both expire, they will now stack as long as they expire within a 30 minute period of each other.
[*]    Reverted a previous change, now gathered items below level 15 can be sold for gold again.
[*]    Lowered Repair costs substantially
[*]    Lowered Gnogmenting costs substantially
[*]    Right-clicking on a crafting recipe in the crafting list will now inspect it.
[*]    Repair kits will now 'stick' to your cursor if you have sticky cursor enabled (makes it a lot easier to repair items quickly).
[*]    The experience portion of the stats window has been updated with further detail, breaking down specific skills and activities
[*]    Equipping a gathering or crafting tool will now influence the experience portion of the stats window
[*]    Previously, there was a special exception to village rules that allowed the founder of a village to join a private guild village, even after leaving the guild. This exception has been removed.
[*]    Improved the Party tooltips to clarify how party experience is split, hopefully will mean less confusions for new players.
[*]    Improved the frame rate in Blackfury Gorge
[*]    Skarn no longer drops runes of power or runes of healing, however he maintains his other abilities (While this does make him easier, the runes were riddled with bugs and causing issues, and with level cap raise it's okay that he is a little easier).
[*]    Renamed "The Item Shop" to "The Shop"
[*]    Made it so when auto gather picks up a bunch of gathered items, the collection sound only plays once and is less intrusive.
[*]    Lowered the amount of Traven Effluxes and Pyrrick Acorns are need to craft high level gear.
[*]    Tweaked a few lower level items levels and recipes in preparation for upcoming work on some tutorial quests.
[*]    Removed the red and yellow "danger" skulls over the heads of powerful enemies.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes [/b]
[list]
  [*]  Fixed: Garnets only drop during the quest "Jewel-Studded Bee Stinger Collar."
  [*]  Fixed a client issue that was causing all sorts of bugs (like not showing inventory sorting, causing crafting bugs, making vendors not work etc.)
  [*]  Fixed: Floating tree You are at 3 209 142 in Elk Meadow
  [*]  Fixed: Glittermore day and night skies didn't look super great in Lakeside
  [*]  Fixed: A stuck issue in Cronk island
  [*]  Fixed: Some bags could not be opened (supply bags, Halcyon bag, etc.)
  [*]  Fixed: an issue with Elysian fields that was making the effect negative
  [*]  Fixed: when gnogmenting, free remakes would have a blank "Cost" section instead of saying "Free".
  [*]  Fixed: Cobalt Dragon Scales outfit for the male (only) are missing textures
  [*]  Fixed: dragging-and-dropping a feat into an empty slot wouldn't work.
  [*]  Fixed: in village project gold donation box, wouldn't work if a line was empty.
  [*]  Fixed: The contribution stacks for village daily tasks had a text too large, so they'd go to two lines and get cut off.
  [*]  Fixed: the "Village will go open" text was black, making it hard to read.
  [*]  Fixed: project description for Blacksmith and Woodcrafting (shields are made in woodcrafting station, not smithy).
  [*]  Hopefully fixed issue causing Shared Trunk to say you need to buy it (until you open it a second time) even if you already own it.
  [*]  Fixed: shift-clicking an item in the vendor item list while Sell or Repair tab was up would not sell or repair it.
  [*]  Fixed: if selling or repairing an item didn't work (e.g. because of shift-clicking a gem while the repair tab is up), a message box will pop up with an error.
  [*]  Fixed: sometimes items would seem to move illegally (e.g. equip item of wrong class) but relogging would fix them. These should now fix themselves right away.
  [*]  Fixed: switching from one character to another would sometimes make quests disappear from the quest tracker or have a wrong tooltip.
  [*]  Hopefully fixed an issue causing certain persisting buffs (such as bounty boost) to appear to be gone when you log in (though they are still in effect).
  [*]  The way daily bonus works has been internally changed. This may make daily bonus more consistent, but could cause daily bonuses for certain players to reset to day 1 shortly after the build goes live. This will only be once for this build, there shouldn't be any intentional resets in future.
  [*]  Fixed a bug that was causing Zingara in Blackfury Gorge to only drop 1 Charter token instead of 3. Some players also noted that the XP is low on these Zingara, that is working as intended and intentional.
  [*]  Fixed a bug where Mutagen's minions wouldn't help her. They are now summoned directly to her side.
  [*]  Fixed a bug that was making it so refined ingredients and ornaments couldn't be sold to vendors.
  [*]  Fixed an issue that was allowing expired items to be used.
  [*]  Fixed some recipe level issues with warrior swords with Slash.
  [*]  Fixed an issue with recipes for hunter bows with slowing shot that were asking for silk that was higher level than the bow.
  [*]  Fixed: mushroom gather nodes in cook cavern are partially submerged in the ground.
  [*]  Fixed: The fruit trees in Oak Valley are labeled as "Apple Tree" and should be just "Fruit Tree"
  [*]  Fixed: Remake no longer repairs an item.
[/list]


[h1]General Info[/h1]
To enter Bevyn's Coille, the Key to the North is required. As before, players can obtain the key upon completion of the quest, Benefactor of the Shard. If you accidentally threw the key away, but have completed that quest, then The Benefactress will give you another key. If you have the key from a previous rebirth, it will still work. However, if you threw the key away and then did a rebirth and did not complete that quest, then you will have to do it again, as well as those Pyrrus story quests leading up to it.

notes.title: Patch 3.7.5 is here! Part 1
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW CONTENT IS HERE![/h1]

[b][u]The Voyage Through the Blighted Isles: Part 1 - The Secret of the Coille[/u][/b]
[list]
   [*] Level cap raised to 77 for all skills
   [*] A Brand New Zone: Bevyn's Coille
   [*] New Story and Quests
   [*] New Bosses, Achievements, Daily Quests, Items, Recipes, Monsters, Music, and more!
[/list]


[b][u]New Features[/u][/b]
[list]
   [*][b] New Feature: Legendary Crafting [/b]
       [*] Crafters who craft weapons and gear that are level 70 and higher will now be able to participate in legendary crafting.
       [*] As a player crafts normal weapons and armor, they will become more proficient in their skill with that exact recipe.
       [*] A players ability to craft a recipe will be represented by ranks. Rank one is will be rather easy to obtain, but getting all the way to rank 5 will take effort.
       [*] As a player progresses through recipe ranks, they will begin to craft better items that contain boosts to the items basic stats, boosting things like health, armor, elemental damage, elemental protection, and more.
       [*] At rank 5, a crafter will have a chance to create a legendary item, which can randomly be one of 9 versions for weapons, or one or 4 versions for garb (including hat, gloves, boots, belt, and outfit). Some versions will have different stat boosts, and some are better than others, but all legendary items will have all of their feats, spells, and proficiencies boosted by an entire rank.
       [*] Work diligently by yourself, mastering recipes for your class, or work with others and swap items as you become proficient in recipes. Will you have what it takes to create the ultimate gear?
   [*][b] New Feature: Item Salvaging [/b]
       [*] Players can now salvage refined ingredients from weapons and armor.
       [*] Head to Ardent City and find the Salvaging Rod Vendor to find a Salvaging Rod that is useful for your level range.
       [*] Functioning similar to how Repair Kits work, hold the Salvaging Rod over the item you wish to deconstruct. Your character will perform the salvaging, the base item will be destroyed, and you will gain some refined ingredients.
       [*] The type and quantity of items salvaged will vary depending on item level and quality, with crafted items producing more than items found in the world.
       [*] Each Salvaging Rod contains 100 charges, so carry one along on your adventures to help keep your inventory clean, and get a few extra refined ingredients at the same time.
   [*][b] Inventory Quality of Life Improvements: [/b]
       [*] We have added inventory sorting. Players can select which bags to be sorted to have all items in the selected bags put in a nice organized manner.
       [*] We have added a "sell gems" button to all vendors. This will sell all of the gems in your bags to the vendor in one click.
       [*] The sounds while moving items around in the inventory have been improved.
   [*][b] New Feature: Elite Crafting Quests [/b]
       [*] Many players enjoy that crafting is a difficult task that requires a character to put the work in to become a master at their skills. While we enjoy this aspect as well, we wanted to make crafting a little more accessible early game so players have a better chance to test the waters before their combat level is too far above crafting.
       [*] We have made crafting much easier from levels 1-40. All skills require a much smaller amount of Xp to level up until about level 42-43.
       [*] At level 40 in a crafting skill, an Elite crafting quest will open up. This quest will be challenging, but reward the player with a boost that permanently increases XP gains in a specific crafting skill by 50%.
       [*] The elite crafting quests will be a marker in the players life, noting when the 'easy waters' of crafting stop, and the challenging end game crafting begins.
   [*][b] Node depletion has been removed (mostly) [/b]
       [*] We have made one final tweak to gathering based on the feedback we have been hearing from the players. We have removed node depletion (with one exception). Instead tools will now wear down faster, and when your tool is broken you can no longer gather (this will prevent botters).
       [*] However, now, while gathering, special repair consumables will 'pop' out of the gathering node. These little globs will not get picked up by auto gather, but must be manually picked up. Players should see them anywhere from every 2-3 minutes (so it is by no means a lot of extra clicking). Picking a globule up will repair your tool, so you can keep on gathering. As long as you are picking up most of the repair globs, you will be able to gather for several hours (without having to rezone to repair tools and replenish nodes)
       [*] The only exception is legacy item shop gathering tools (golden tools) since these items can never break down, they will still use the node depletion with the same balanced numbers as before.
   [*][b] Death Recap [/b]
       [*] The death window will now explain about the last few attacks that damaged you, follwed by what the killing blow was. This will include the monsters name, what type of attack, how much damage, if it was a critical strike, and what element of damage it was. The hope is that this will help give players bit more information so they can better prepare themselves and understand base game mechanics.
[/list]


[b][u]Improvements[/u][/b]
[list]
   [*][b] XP Balancing[/b]
      [*]  We have made some XP table balancing in preparation for new content
      [*]  Combat XP: levels 35-55 have been lowered. Levels 55-65 then smoothly readjust back to regular amount. Levels 1-34 and 66-75 are unchanged.
      [*]  Village XP (Ranching and Gardening): Values from 45-65 were lowered slightly.
      [*]  Crafting XP: Values from levels 10 to 40 have been lowered substantially in preparation for level 40 elite crafting quests.
      [*]  Gathering XP: Values from 10 to 40 mirror the crafting changes.
   [b] Charter Adjustments: [/b]
      [*]  Non-combat charters have had their combat XP reduced to match reduced XP tables.
      [*] Guard charters had their combat XP lowered slightly to match reduced XP tables.
      [*]  Parts charters level 75 and above will now require less parts, but also require the player to travel to a zone, killing 1-2 monsters that match the part they are collecting.
      [*]  Parts charters have had their combat XP boosted slightly
   [b] Pyrron Changes [/b]
      [*]  Golden Chests of Pyrron, obtain from the dragons of the Deep earth, no longer contain class rings.
      [*]  The Arcane Rift is no longer required to complete the Pyrrus story line. The Rift still exists and the bosses are still within, however they no longer drop special monster parts and they no longer require heroes to have specific elder gear.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.1.1 (part 1)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gathering Changes[/h1]
[list]
      [*]  Boosted Mote of Yorick drop chance across the board
           [*] Base chance: boosted from 5% to 15%
           [*] Hasty Herb Chance: boosted from 0.5%-5% (level 1, level 75) to 3%-9%.
           [*] Normal Herb Chance: boosted from 1.5%-15% (level 1, level 75) to 7%-21%
           [*] Yorick's Jewlery: boosted from 4%-20% to 5%-26%
           [*] Gold price dropped from 14s 95c to 12s 95c.
           [*] Changed it so if you have Mote Find greater than 100%, you get a chance at a second Mote of Yorick.
           [*] Cornucopia have been boosted. Instead of 3 charges at 90%, they now contain 5 charges a 100%. All charter variations are rebalanced to take this into account. The chance to find them is now slightly more rare (0.5%)
           [*] Gathering hats now also increases the chance to find Motes of Yorick by 15%. With the new base mote chance of 15%, this doubles a hat wearers chances to find Motes of Yorick.
      [*]  We have removed all ranks of supplies (ranks being the level ranges). Instead all supplies of a gathering skill will work at any level node.
           [*] We kept all the rarities of supplies (common, superior, premium).
           [*] We have added two new types of supplies: No trade superior and No trade premium. These items will work just like normal superior and premium supplies, but they will be separate items (including a different name and a different icon).
       [*] This will leave a total of five items per gathering skill:
            [*] Common Supplies (No Trade)
            [*] Superior Supplies (No Trade)
            [*] Premium Supplies (No Trade)
            [*] Superior Supplies (Trade-able)
            [*] Premium Supplies (Trade-able)
       [*] In total this will be 20 item (5 items * 4 skills) compared to 48 items from the old system (4 ranks * 3 rarities * 4 skills). That is 28 items less.
       [*] This is where and how you will acquire these items:
           [*] Common Supplies (No Trade): Can be found while gathering, Will be given out by daily distributors, can be purchased with COG coins.
           [*] Superior Supplies (No Trade): Can be purchased using COG coins.
           [*] Premium Supplies (No Trade): Can be purchased using COG coins.
           [*] Superior Supplies (Tradable): Can be found while gathering.
           [*] Premium Supplies (Tradable): Can be found while gathering, can be purchased using charter tokens.
       [*] All COG values (buy / sell / trade) have been adjusted to fit the new system.
           [*] COG patrons will now accept any type of supply in exchange for COG coins (common, superior, premium, superior (no trade), premium (no trade)).
           [*] A Note on this:[i] All five can go in, but only three can come out. This means any of the five supply types listed above can be traded to a COG patron, but only the three no trade versions can by purchased using COG coins. Consequently, players can never take a trade-able supply, trade it with COG, and get a trade-able supply back out. The COG patron will give you a special warning about this issue.[/i]
       [*] Common Supplies will no longer be sold for Gold.
       [*] COG coins can now be purchased with Gold.
       [*] Transition from old types to new types:
           [*] All old supply types will be converted to new types by the system when the build goes live.
           [*] Any unopened bounty salvage, charter bags, or daily bags, will now contain the new type of item.
           [*] If somehow a player still has an old item type after the build goes live, that item will still work for gathering.
       [*] Xinzen carp were balanced to take into account the new changes.
       [*] Normal Herbs that give the Abundant Earth effect, now last for 20 minutes rather than 5. Hasty herb duration remains the same.
       [*] Bounties no longer drop Bounty Salvage. Instead bounties will give COG coins based on the level of the bounty.
       [*] COG coins now stack to 9500 (used to be 5000)
       [*] When a character first gathers with no supplies selected, a tutorial message appears.
[/list]


  [h1]  Improvements [/h1]
[list]
      [*]  We made the X that indicates an item cannot be used smaller and less aggressive
      [*]  Made Mail text and Auction House quantity text easier to read.
      [*]  The "Mail" button was moved into the top-left HUD frame, and now flashes when new mail is received, as it did before Reborn.
      [*]  The dark background behind the crafting window, friends window, and all the other windows has been removed, allowing you to chat and move items about while the windows are open.
      [*]  Changed "Social" to "Friends"
      [*]  When a character first gathers with no supplies selected, show a tutorial popup.
[/list]

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 2
notes.notes:
[b](continued from part 1)[/b]

There are three different categories of supplies, and each yields a greater benefit to the player who has equipped their tools with them. However, it is not a requirement that one must equip their tools in order to gather.

[list]

[h1][b]Using No Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 5 second gathering time
[*]50% chance to find gathering material (e.g. fish, ore, wood, etc.)
[*]100% chance to find 1-2 common gathering supplies for the current skill
[*]0% chance to find supplies for another skill

[h1][b]Using Common Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 3 second gathering time
[*]100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
[*]50% chance to find supplies for another skill (nectar, grindstones, etc.)

[h1][b]Using Superior Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 2 second gathering time
[*]100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc)
[*]75% chance to find gathering supplies for another skill (grindstones, nectar, etc.)

[h1][b]Using Premium Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 1 second gathering time
[*]100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
[*]100% chance to find supplies for another skill (grindstone, worms, etc.)
[/list]

Superior and Premium Supplies are fully trade-able. Common supplies, unlike the others, are not trade-able. However, every 22 hours, all players will have a stock amount of Common Supplies replenished for free, if they visit certain NPC's. These NPC's, Distributors, belong to a special group known as the Coterie of Gatherers (C.O.G. for short) and they can be found in Ardent City, Summer’s Hollow, and on the shores of Lake Kiwa, with the other members of their Coterie. C.O.G members are easily recognizable in their green robes and blazing gold emblems.

[h1][b]Who are the members of the C.O.G, and what do they do?[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Distributors: C.O.G Distributors will serve out daily rations of supplies to all players. There is a C.O.G Distributor for Fishing, Mining, Plant Lore, and Bug Lore. Visit each of them once per day to collect your share.
[*]Patrons: C.O.G Patrons will take Common Supplies from you in trade for C.O.G. coins. C.O.G. coins can be redeemed at a C.O.G. Quartermaster.
[*]Quartermasters: C.O.G Quartermasters will sell you Common Supplies in exchange for varying rates of C.O.G coins.
[*]Vendors: C.O.G. Vendors will sell Common Supplies for varying rates of gold, the official currency of the Seven Realms.
[/list]

* C.O.G npc's only deal in Common Supplies, not Superior or Premium.

[h1][b]Motes of Yorick[/b][/h1]
When gathering, players will have a chance to find a Mote of Yorrick. These small energy orbs can be used to rapidly craft (in lieu of a mass producer.) These special Motes can also be purchased for gold, but they will not be sold in the item shop. Mass Producers will continue to be sold in the item shop, as will Clockwork Harvesters.

[h1][b]Where are all of these gathering supplies kept?[/b][/h1]
A tool bar will appear whenever players are engaged in a gathering skill. There are 3 slots in the bar, each slot relegated for common, superior, and premium supplies. Each slot holds 2500 supplies. Each of the four gathering skills have three such slots. (All of these slots are free.) The Character Window, in the ‘Skills’ section, also displays a player’s supplies.

Additionally, we have increased the inventory amount in bags, vaults, and lockers to 1000.

[h1][b]What happens to all your Vim and Vim-related items?[/b][/h1]
Vim has been removed entirely from the game. When you log in, all vim-related items will no longer be in your possession, but will have been converted into a special in-game currency called Crystallized Vim Shards. You will now have a choice of what you want to spend the Shards on. If you want to buy back the same items, which have been altered to fit the new system, you can. Or, if you decide you'd rather spend your Shards on other items within the new gathering system, you can do that as well. The choice is entirely yours.

In Ardent City, up near the castle, are a group of special NPC's dressed in purple. They will exchange items with you.

Here is a list of vim-related items, and how they now fit into the new system:

[list]

[h1][b]Cornucopia:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Gave a small amount of Vim.
[*]New System: Eating a cornucopia gives you a charged buff (similar to how a deluxe clockwork harvester works.) With the buff, the next time you gather you have a 90% increased chance to find a Mote of Yorick. The effect expires after a total of 3 gathers (charges). The charges scale up with the cooking/charter recipes.
[*]Note: The Overflowing Cornucopia recipe now requires 30 Cornucopias instead of 20, but it's Charter cost was reduced from 850 to 600 tokens.

[h1][b]Bounty Bosses:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Killing a bounty boss in your level range restored 2 Vim.
[*]New System: All bounty bosses (regardless of level difference) reward a crate that contains various types of supplies. The level of supplies depends on the level of the bounty boss.
[*]Old System: Killing a bounty gave you 1 stack on a buff that stacked to 75, each stack increased your maximum Vim by 2.
[*]New System: Bounty power works the same (1 stack per kill, stacks to 75). The buff now grants bonus chance to find supplies while gathering, and when you do find supplies, it increases the amount you find.

[h1][b]Bugs:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased max Vim.
[*]New System: While gathering, the chance to recycle (not use your selected supply) is increased.


[h1][b]Herbs:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: eating herbs restored Vim.
[*]New System:
22 hour Herbs - Grants the Abundant Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
2 hour Herbs - Grants the Bountiful Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Abundant Earth and Bountiful Earth may be active simultaneously.

[h1][b]Magical Seeds:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: could be grown and consumed to increase max vim and replenish vim.
[*]New System:
Magic Vegetables now grant a large boost to gardening experience (the harvest can then be sold to a vendor or destroyed).
Magic Spices now grant a boost to sale price (gold).
Note: Magical seeds no longer tie into the gathering or crafting system.

[h1][b]Cooking Potions:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased Vim regeneration.
[*]Renamed: Potions of the Triad (the Legendary Three)
[*]New System: Your luck and prosperity while gathering, crafting, and working in your village is boosted. This includes recipe cost reduction while crafting, abundant harvests while gardening, and both lucky find and bonus supplies while gathering.

[h1][b]Yorick's Jewelry:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased Max Vim
[*]New System: You have an increased chance at finding a Mote of Yorick while gathering. Additionally, your chance to find supplies is boosted.

[h1][b]Xinzen Carp:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Could be consumed to give a swim speed boost and make it so you would gain Vim rather than spending it.
[*]New System: Can now be filleted to find what the fish has been munching on. Contains a swim speed potion and various large amounts of COG coins (used to purchase gathering supplies).

[h1][b]Charter Rewards:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Vim potions could be purchased for various amounts of Charter Tokens.
[*]New System: All charter vendors now sell superior gathering supplies.

[b]{continued in part 3)[/b]

[*]Old System: Increased Max Vim

[*]Old System: Could be consumed to give a swim speed boost and make it so you would gain Vim rather than spending it.

[*]Old System: Vim potions could be purchased for various amounts of Charter Tokens.
[*]New System: All charter vendors now sell superior gathering supplies.
